snippet.title: Wasteland Remastered Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Available Now: https://www.inxile-entertainment.com/wasteland-remastered

Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. Bring law to a lawless future or burn everything to the ground with full freedom of choice and consequence. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.

---
inXile is now making Clockwork Revolution - a first-person, time-bending steampunk RPG set in 1890's Victorian England. Change the past. Control the future. Coming to Xbox Series X|S and PC in 2027.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439280/Clockwork_Revolution/
Clockwork Revolution playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLe5_loi8VYAU
